svg.title: Observed flow-duration shapes retain each gauge's own context
svg.desc: Solid circles show the selected complete calendar year; open squares show the pointwise median of other complete years at the same gauge. The view covers Q5–Q95. Q5 is the observed 95th percentile and Q95 is the observed 5th percentile, using R7 interpolation; complete Q0–Q100 records remain in flow-duration.csv. Panel discharge axes retain their own numeric ranges. Eighteenmile, Kettle and Stevens use 2023 with other complete 2020–2025 years; Augusta Canal uses 2025 with its only other complete year, 2020. Original catchment, regulation and diversion identities remain attached to each gauge.
